$comment: The instruction line of each end a copy can ask, for the comparison templates whose copies ask the two ends in turn (types/_shared/size-compare.js K-032 K-035 K-037 K-079, measurement-tasks.js K-038, compare-groups.js K-008; 2026-11-17, the Position Words model). order[0] is the end the published pages ask: its line is the registered instruction (i18n/strings.<loc>.json) word for word, and copy 1 of every level asks it; a copy that asks order[1] prints that line (copyInstruction). K-038 "screen": the tap line of each end (order[0] = i18n/interactive-instructions.json measurement.heavier). K-008 fewer = the registered lines of K-009. The other ends are DRAFTS awaiting the native review (qa/verify-ask-lines.js checks the published ends).
